Most of the accommodations feature breathtaking views of the lake or the vibrant greenery of our gardens, providing a serene atmosphere for relaxation. Thang Loi Hotel is also a trusted venue for hosting a variety of events, from corporate meetings to both intimate and grand wedding receptions. Guests will be warmly greeted by our attentive and friendly staff, dedicated to delivering exceptional service and ensuring an unforgettable stay. Rooms & Suites At Thang Loi Hotel, you will enjoy rooms designed in a modern style with environmentally friendly wooden furniture and marble bathrooms. The quiet space here is ideal for relaxation, offering a stunning view of the lush greenery of Hanoi from the hotel’s spacious windows.
